# Greg Swierad

> Greg Swierad (Grzegorz Świerad) is a Polish founder who builds mobile apps and the growth
> behind them. He runs Subida AI, a mobile app studio, and created Mentorist (500,000+ users,
> 500+ A/B tests, a €550k round). Before that he was CTO and then CEO of IQElite in Barcelona
> (8 million registered users, break-even within 90 days). He is a podcast guest on app growth,
> A/B testing, paid acquisition and building products with AI agents.

What this site is and is not: gregswierad.com is Greg's personal site and media kit for
podcast hosts, about Greg as a person and a guest. It is not a sales page: app development and
marketing projects run through his studio Subida AI (https://subida.ai/en), not through this site.

Disambiguation: other people share the name Grzegorz Świerad. This one is the app founder:
creator of Mentorist, founder of Subida AI, former CTO and CEO of IQElite. He is not connected
to other businesses run by people of the same name.

Key facts:

- Name: Greg Swierad; Polish spelling Grzegorz Świerad
- Role: founder of Subida AI (https://subida.ai/en), a mobile app studio based in Poland that builds, designs and markets iOS and Android apps
- Mentorist (https://www.mentorist.app/): app that helps people apply what they read in books; 500,000+ users, 500+ A/B tests, €550k round; Facebook Ads was the main growth channel
- IQElite (Barcelona): matching platform built on IQ, personality and compatibility tests; Greg was CTO on the founding team, then CEO eighteen months later; break-even within 90 days, profitable for the next 8 years, 8 million registered users, five-person team
- Paid ads: €700k+ spent on Meta ads, much of it his own money
- Other projects: English Series (iOS app built end to end), Lighthouse (subscription life tracker: product design, marketing, growth), Silne Dziecko (500 copies sold in pre-sale), Neurony Szaleją (six-figure yearly revenue on paid traffic), 1st place at HackYeah 2025
- Works with AI agents every day: code, ad creatives and landing pages
- Podcast languages: English and Polish
- Recording: remote, on the host's platform (Riverside, Zoom, StreamYard and others); from a short chat to a long-form interview
- How to invite him: the form at https://gregswierad.com/podcast#contact; reply within 24 hours
- Gift for listeners of the shows he appears on: a free month of Naralingo and a Mentorist subscription at https://gregswierad.com/listeners
- Profiles: https://linkedin.com/in/gregswierad · https://fractio.pl/eksperci/grzegorz-swierad

## Podcast topics

- [500+ A/B tests: what they teach about apps](https://gregswierad.com/topics/ab-testing): what moves conversion and retention in a subscription app, how to prioritise tests with little traffic, onboarding vs paywall vs features.
- [From zero to 500k+ users: the Mentorist story](https://gregswierad.com/topics/growing-a-subscription-app): building a subscription app from idea to scale, a €550k round, Facebook Ads as the main channel, the costliest mistakes.
- [One person with AI agents instead of a department](https://gregswierad.com/topics/building-with-ai-agents): a working day with AI agents, the English Series app built end to end, where AI fails.
- [Turnaround: from CTO to CEO and break-even in 90 days](https://gregswierad.com/topics/startup-turnaround): IQElite, what to cut in a five-person team, moving from technology to running the company.
- [Advertising that pays for itself](https://gregswierad.com/topics/paid-ads-that-pay-back): €700k+ on Meta ads, acquisition cost and payback in a subscription model, creatives, pre-sales as a market test.
- [Product design and marketing are one decision](https://gregswierad.com/topics/product-design-and-marketing): the ad's promise must match the app's first screen, Lighthouse, lean growth.
